title: Thread-Safe Counter
description: Implement a counter safe for concurrent threads.
context: Used in backend systems handling concurrency.
codeSnippet:
import threading

class Counter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.value = 0
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def increment(self):
        with self.lock:
            self.value += 1

counter = Counter()
counter.increment()
print(counter.value)

title: Producer-Consumer Queue
context: Common backend and distributed systems interview question.
codeSnippet:
import queue
import threading

q = queue.Queue()

def producer():
    q.put('item')

def consumer():
    item = q.get()
    print(item)

threading.Thread(target=producer).start()
threading.Thread(target=consumer).start()
